notes.title: Splurge Anniversary Update
notes.content:
The one year anniversary of Splurge's early access release is here! To celebrate this milestone, the Anniversary Update (v0.3) has been released! This update adds a new gamemode, game modifiers, and much more!

NEW GAMEMODE:
Tired of the current game loop? Well great news! The new gamemode changes the way you play the game! Previously, the only way to win was to eliminate every other player and be the last one standing. It didn't matter how you got there; whether you were dominant for the entire game or managed to scrape by and get a lucky chain of splurges to steal victory at the last second. Now when you play in this new gamemode, each player collects points at the end of every turn for the amount of tiles you currently have claimed. You also get a small handful of points each time you splurge a tile. When there's only one person left, instead of that person automatically winning, the person with the most points wins.

MODIFIERS:
The only way you used to be able to customise your splurging experience were changing basic settings (map size, map type, etc). Now with the addition of modifiers, there are vastly more customisation options for the game, allowing for increased replayability. This update introduces 4 modifiers, each unique and designed to be compatible with one another, with more planned for the future. The current four are listed below:
Fog: Any tile that is not owned by you, or adjacent or diagonal to you is shrouded in a thick layer of fog, limiting your visibility of the map. The visibility is dynamic, meaning gaining or losing tiles will change where the fog is covering.
Blind: Every other team's colour is replaced with the default white colour, meaning you can't see where everyone else's tiles are, or how much progress they have on them. You can still see when players place on a tile, or when their tile splurges.
Sleepy: At the start of the game, some tiles will be 'asleep', meaning they can't be directly placed on, effectively rendering them as barricades. The only way to claim them is to splurge into them from an adjacent tile. However, a tile additionally goes to sleep whenever it splurges.
Expansion: After the first turn, players will only be able to place new tiles next to the ones they already own. This allows for players to get boxed in and besieged by others - something that was previously not possible.
Note: for the fog and blind modifiers, if you try to place on someone else's tile that you can't see, the game rejects your move and skips your turn, so placing blindly to figure out where everyone is isn't an option for these modifiers!

OTHER CHANGES:

Added two new simple maps; Four Corners and Grid
Added one new song that plays during tile decay
Added 4 new steam achievements relating to the new content
Lots of visual changes, touch ups and polishes
Improvements to the UI to make it smoother and more intuitive
Fixed many seemingly random crashes, softlocks, and other bugs and glitches


I hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Minor Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
Small update to add on to content from v0.2.

Changes:


Added no new maps
Added a new song that can play rarely
3 new achievements for beating each of the three maps, as well as a hidden achievement
Added a sound for when tiles disappear during decay
Fixed issue on mirror map where you could only interact with the center portion of the map
Changed how decay works on mirror and donut maps (now decays from the inside)
Changes to improve controller playing experience
Many more miniscule bug fixes/visual changes
(And no new maps)

notes.title: Many More Maps Update
notes.content:
Hello all my loyal splurgeheads! After a (slight) wait, the Many More Maps Update (v0.2) is here! The primary focus of the update is the three new maps that have been added into the game, which are detailed here:

MEGA SPLURGE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787992/d505ff089054800d78696e7085bb8f86e8ab7811.png
Replaces the center 4x4 area of the map with a giant tile. The tile is easy to take control over and splurges into 16 adjacent tiles, but takes 16 turns to fill up.

MAZE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787992/f7a01cad08fc1a9421e5aa24bf3b6997d9c3c4e2.png
The map is now a claustrophobic network of ranadomly generated long corridors. Getting high splurge combos is easy on this map, but extra care is required!
 
MIRROR
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787992/d3efe50589faa89bdc64af05608c0ac7086a7133.png
This map tesselates infinitely, and it goes on seemingly forever. There's nowhere to hide on this map!

Full Changelog:

General content changes:

Added 3 new maps
Added 3 songs to the soundtrack
Removed the Islands map
Added jingles to the start and end of the game
Changed the decay alarm sound

Gameplay changes:

You can no longer win by getting a high enough combo
Decreased the default decay speed
Players can no longer place on a tile with max progress of one
Added a prompt for when players try to place on a tile they can't place on
Added an ability to save/load map presets
Quit to menu button now requires you to double click it

Visual changes:

Improved win screen transition
Added random tiles to the background of the game
Background now goes red when tile decay begins
Tiles now bounce periodically
Added particles to the background of the game
Changed the tile select/hover icon to an arrow

Bug fixes and misc changes:

Fixed some visual bugs related to rendering of tiles
Made slight optimisations to rendering
Fake/decor tiles can no longer overlap each other
Fixed tiles not fully disappearing at the end of the game
Fixed glitch which caused buttons to sometimes not revert colour
Lowered the volume of some repetitive sounds
Fixed an oversight where you could enter a negative decay speed
Fixed glitch where you could open and type in chat while the game was paused
Added chat to the stats screen
